verdict.rationale: An independent TechPowerUp review of the RTX 5080 Founders Edition gives all four memory specs for this exact part: 16 GB capacity, GDDR7, a 256-bit bus and 960 GB/s bandwidth. None of the NVIDIA first-party pages in the pack (product page, DLSS, CUDA Toolkit) list any memory specs, so full publication by the vendor is not shown. Missing for 10: a first-party NVIDIA spec sheet stating capacity, memory type, bus width and bandwidth for the RTX 5080, with the third-party figures corroborating it.
